description.narrative: IFC plans to provide a senior secured loan of up to US$18 million to East Can Solution LLC (the Company). The IFC loan will be used to finance the construction of a new aluminum can production plant in Uzbekistan, which will have an annual capacity of approximately 550 million cans (the Project) and will supply leading beverage manufacturers within the country.

The expected project-level outcomes are Economy-wide Effects: by promoting local production of aluminum cans, the Project is expected to contribute to increased value addition, which will be strengthened through the adoption of cost-efficient production methods, and employment creation. IFC anticipates that the Project will also strengthen domestic supply chains in Uzbekistan and will contribute to import substitution. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that this investment will contribute to the development of metal packaging industry in Uzbekistan, which relies heavily on imports. The Project represents the first large-scale opportunity for the development of Uzbekistan's metal packaging sector, with the potential to showcase the countrys cost competitiveness in this industry.
